hero.title: AI and advanced analytics to improve your decisions and the control of your operation.
hero.sub: We design, build and run the intelligence systems your business needs. Headquartered in Guatemala, delivering across Central America and the United States.

credibility: Clients across Central America and the U.S.

capacidades.title: Three lines of work. One model: build it with you, then hand over the capability.
capacidades.lede: We don't hand you a model and walk away. We design the systems your business needs, deploy them on your own infrastructure, and train your team to run them without us.

items.title: Data & AI Strategy
items.text: Analytics maturity assessment, data architecture, implementation roadmap and use cases prioritized by their real impact on your operation.

items.title: Technical Implementation
items.text: We build data warehouses, predictive models, generative AI platforms and LLM-based enterprise agents — on Databricks, Azure or your current stack.

items.title: Training & Handover
items.text: We train your team to operate what we build. AI fundamentals programs, applied workshops and certifications delivered through Lambda Learn.

clientes.eyebrow: Some of the companies that have trusted us
clientes.title: We work with leading companies in retail, agribusiness, manufacturing, healthcare, technology and financial services.
clientes.lede: Mid-market and large organizations across Central America and the United States that decided to run on data instead of intuition.

metodologia.title: We build it with you. And we teach your team to run it.
metodologia.lede: An advanced analytics firm headquartered in Guatemala, operating across Central America and the United States, founded by a group of professionals with international academic training.

pillars.title: Academic rigor, operational language
pillars.text: Led by professionals with graduate degrees from U.S. universities. We speak business with your board, and engineering with your IT team.

pillars.title: Regional Databricks Partner
pillars.text: We build on the Databricks + Azure ecosystem, dominant in the Mesoamerican enterprise segment. No lock-in, no systems your team can't maintain.

pillars.title: Capability transfer
pillars.text: Your team doesn't end up dependent on us. Lambda Learn trains your people to operate the systems we build.

pillars.title: Nearshore proximity
pillars.text: Same time zone as most of the U.S., a short flight from your offices. We know the operating, regulatory and talent context of the region.

academia.title: Open training for teams already adopting AI.
academia.lede: Short, 100% live courses taught by the same consultants who design AI systems for our enterprise clients. Your team leaves with their environment configured and templates ready to apply the following Monday.

cards.title: AI for HR and Talent Management
cards.text: For HR teams that want to recruit, assess and develop talent using ChatGPT, Gemini and NotebookLM.

cards.title: AI for Productivity
cards.text: For professionals and operating teams that want to win back hours by applying AI to everyday work.

cards.title: AI Fundamentals
cards.text: For leaders and middle managers who need to understand what AI is, and what it can and cannot do, before adopting it.

academia.footText: Need to train a full team, or want a custom program? We design learning tracks for your organization.

cta.title: Ready to tighten the control of your operation?
cta.lede: A first 30-minute conversation is enough for us to understand your context and tell you honestly whether we can help. No commitment.
cta.boxText: Tell us what you're working on. We reply within 24 business hours.
